name: Pixtral Large
description: Multimodal model with strong vision understanding and 128K context.
longDescription: Pixtral Large is Mistral's flagship multimodal model, built on Mistral Large 2 with a 124B parameter architecture. It features a dedicated 1B parameter vision encoder and excels at document understanding, chart interpretation, and natural image analysis.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
from mistralai import Mistral

client = Mistral(api_key="YOUR_MISTRAL_API_KEY")
response = client.chat.complete(
    model="pixtral-large-latest",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
